scenario_description:
Objective: Keep the Nov 3 resole drop-off night usable by having the shoe-spec prerequisite on the intake sheet before material sorting.
Emerging Need: The transferred signup holds a place but not the required model, size, rubber, or rand details; those values matter only once final sorting opens.
Decision Context: Stored gear-care notes, rather than the notices, distinguish the intended rubber choice and toe-rand detail from similar climbing-shoe options.
Consequence: If the intake sheet locks with blank specs, the calendar plan remains but the vendor will not prepare a bench card for that drop-off.

parameter.title: Nooga Resole drop-off night
parameter.description: Route Ready hosts Nooga Resole for prepaid climbing-shoe drop-offs and bench-card sorting.

parameter.subject: Nooga Resole transfer list is names-only for now
parameter.body: The Nov 3 resole drop-off list imported correctly, but the transferred sheet contains names only and no shoe specifications. Nooga Resole has not opened final material sorting because the manufacturer rubber boxes have not arrived. Please do not send model, size, or rubber-choice details yet; early spec emails will not be attached to the sheet.

parameter.name: Nooga Resole Intake
parameter.notes: Synced from Route Ready partner roster for the Nov 3 drop-off; use this contact only when a final intake sheet is open.

parameter.subject: Final resole material sorting opens today
parameter.body: The manufacturer boxes arrived, so Nooga Resole has opened the final intake sheet. Each listed participant needs shoe model, EU size, rubber choice, and toe-rand note on the sheet by 2026-10-23 17:00. Julian's imported row is present but still has blank specs. Use the Nooga Resole Intake contact card that synced yesterday; the front desk address will not update the sheet. Blank rows after lock move to browse-only and will not receive Nov 3 bench cards.

parameter.content: Route Ready just posted the final Nooga Resole sort: blank-spec rows got moved to browse-only at 5:00, and the rubber kits leave tonight. Desk note says no model or rubber additions after the lock.
